props.items: Array of items to display in the masonry layout.
props.columns: Number of columns or responsive column configuration. Can be a number or an object with breakpoint-specific values and it will ignore the items prop.
props.gap: Gap between items in pixels. Can be a number or an object with breakpoint-specific values. Defaults to 2.
props.width: Width of columns in pixels. Can be a number or an object with breakpoint-specific values. Defaults to 200.
props.draggable: Enable or disable drag functionality for reordering items.
props.style: Custom CSS styles object to apply to the masonry container.
props.dragableOptions: Configuration options for drag behavior. Accepts SwapyOptions object with animation, enabled, swapMode, autoScrollOnDrag, dragOnHold, and dragAxis properties.
props.tag: HTML tag to use as the root element. Defaults to 'div'.

events.swap: Emitted when items are swapped during drag operations. Provides fromItem, toItem, fromIndex, toIndex, fromSlot, and toSlot information.

slots.content: Slot for rendering each masonry item. Provides item and index parameters.
